item.title: Jury awards $6 million to former Wyoming Boys’ School resident for punitive isolation
item.description: A jury late Thursday awarded a former resident of the Wyoming Boys’ School $6 million after concluding staff there subjected him to punitive isolation and denied him due process to challenge his confinement.

item.description: As investigators probe what caused a New York City building collapse that killed eight people, workers and residents are painting a portrait of two trouble spots side-by-side: the apartment house that fell down and the construction site being excavated next door.

item.title: Officials: Washington pulp mill violated safety standards before ruptured chemical tank killed 11
item.description: State investigators have revealed that a Washington pulp mill, where a chemical tank ruptured in May killing 11 people, had a history of severe safety violations.

item.title: China's nuclear buildup is 'hot and heavy,' Trump says a day after meeting with Xi
item.description: President Donald Trump says China is building nuclear weapons at a "hot and heavy" pace. His comments to reporters Friday were his first after his meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
